fixtures.title: Deep Learning for Mobile Channel Estimation
fixtures.text:
1. Introduction
Existing wireless models often assume stable channel conditions, which breaks down in highly mobile environments. We propose a neural channel estimator.
2. Methods
We construct a 5-layer convolutional neural network trained on synthetic ray-tracing channels.
3. Results
Table 1: Accuracy metrics. Our model achieved 94.2% accuracy under high Doppler shifts.
4. Limitations
Computational complexity limits real-time FPGA deployment on edge devices.

fixtures.title: Quantum Memory Registers for Distributed Computing
fixtures.text:
Introduction
Quantum registers suffer from rapid decoherence.
Methods
We use fault-tolerant surface codes to stabilize qubit states.
Results
Decoherence time increased by 3.5x compared to baseline transmon qubits.
Limitations
Requires cryogenic cooling below 15mK.

fixtures.text: Abstract: We evaluate vision transformers for tumor segmentation in 3D MRI scans, achieving high Dice scores.
